answer: Sockpuppet farms fail a 24-hour shale deposit that freezes 330 of my spendable POA. To thaw it I must post sixteen hash-linked timber rings, one every 90 minutes, each signed by a one-time key revealed only when the next ring is published, so a copied identity cannot sign two schedules at once. The opening SHA-256 commitment and the ring timetable are recorded in a public atlas any peer can audit; a missed ring, key reuse, or atlas mismatch slashes the deposit in full.
